ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 75% high-intensity white central pixels bounded by 25% low-intensity black peripheral pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white fields occupy the central regions of both lobes; a 10-20 pixel wide black pigmented band follows the trailing edge; a distinct dark vertically-oriented marking is present in the mid-left lobe quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire visible trailing edge; peak-to-valley amplitude varies between 5 and 15 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge tapering towards the distal tips; left lobe is oriented at a positive incline relative to the horizontal plane.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized dark focal clusters (approx. 5-10 pixels in diameter) observed on the lower-inner white field of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large brown fibrous entanglement mass (rope/netting) wrapped around the distal tip of the left fluke lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Vertical high-contrast water droplet trails descending from the left fluke tip and entanglement mass.
